characters.name: Pim the Turtle
characters.description: a very slow turtle who is never in a hurry and always arrives anyway

characters.name: The Moon
characters.description: a quiet friend who waits behind the chimney and listens

chapters.title: The Slow Turtle Again
chapters.summary: Mira and Pim the Turtle walked to the end of the garden path and counted seven soft things on the way.
chapters.open_thread: There is still one soft thing at the end of the path they did not reach.

chapters.title: Pim and the Sleeping Moon
chapters.summary: Pim and the Moon were watching a little flower grow together tonight.
chapters.open_thread: The stars glittered like tiny ice crystals.

chapters.title: Pim and the Moon's Smile
chapters.summary: The moon and Pim are quiet together, watching stars.

chapters.title: The Moon and Pim
chapters.summary: Pim and The Moon watch snowy flakes. It’s a nice night.
chapters.open_thread: Pim and the snow are really pretty.

chapters.title: Pim and the Soft Snow
chapters.summary: Pim and The Moon are watching snow fall.

chapters.title: Pim and The Moon’s Light
chapters.summary: Pim and The Moon are dreaming of a warm, glowing flame.
chapters.open_thread: Tomorrow, the moon shines even brighter.

chapters.title: Pim and The Moon’s Gentle Sleep
chapters.summary: Tomorrow, the Moon shines a little bit brighter and the snow will fall just a little harder.

chapters.title: Pim and The Moon's Quiet Night
chapters.summary: Tomorrow, the moon shines brighter and the snow falls softly.
chapters.open_thread: Pim found a little leaf. It felt smooth and wet.”

chapters.title: Pim and The Moon’s Sleepy Dream
chapters.summary: Tomorrow, the moon and Pim will watch the snow and the leaf together, making the night so calm.
